cacheHit.description: True when an identical low-poly result already existed (cache-first; the source's content hash + knobs key the cache).

usedMock.description: True when no real Hunyuan provider was configured and a deterministic mock low-poly GLB was produced (quota-safe fallback).

manifest.description: Manifest of the NEW derived low-poly asset. sourceInputAssetPaths references the high-poly source. Textures are NOT preserved.
